Acceptance Criteria: 1. Two medicines with the same active ingredient under different brand names produce one DuplicatePair. 2. Two medicines with different active ingredients but similar brand names produce no DuplicatePair. 3. Normalisation handles case differences and common synonym pairs (paracetamol/acetaminophen). 4. Unreviewed records are excluded from detection. 5. Detection is deterministic: same inputs always produce the same output.
Skills: 1. Unit: synthetic test — same ingredient, different brands → one pair. 2. Unit: synthetic test — different ingredients, similar brands → no pair. 3. Unit: synonyms table resolves paracetamol = acetaminophen. 4. Unit: unreviewed records excluded. 5. Determinism: run twice with same inputs → same output.
